name: Armadillos & skunks
description: Omnivorous armoured and musteloid mesofauna - the large hairy armadillo peludo (Chaetophractus villosus), the pichi (Zaedyus pichiy) and the skunks chingue (Conepatus humboldtii) and chingue austral (C. chinga). Functional group pooling 4 source nodes (4 native, 0 exotic, 0 mixed-origin); they eat insects, rodents, carrion (including guanaco and sheep) and some plants, and are themselves prey for pumas, foxes and raptors. The source even records a skunk preying on the pichi within this guild.
